stem: ![](asset:P000431-stem-1) Two strings of length $l =$ 0.5 m each are connected to a block of mass m = 2 kg at one end and their ends are attached to the point A and B 0.5 m apart on a vertical pole which rotates with a constant angular velocity ω = 7 rad/sec. Find the ratio $T_{1}$: $T_{2}$ of tension in the upper string ($T_{1}$) and the lower string ($T_{2}$). [g = 9.8 m/$s^{2}$]

assets.alt: A 2 kg mass held by two strings to points A and B on a vertical rod: the upper string has tension T₁, the lower T₂.
